title: Freelance Technology Services Analyst
location: Secaucus, NJ
field: -
description:
[under: Responsibilities] - Provide frontline service desk support, including but not limited to answering inbound calls, resolving request and incident tickets, staffing our tech bar, addressing end user issues in person and remotely with punctuality, courtesy, and professionalism, and escalating problems and major incidents promptly.
[under: Responsibilities] - Demonstrate an ongoing interest in personal development, including technology training and certifications, specialization of platform and service delivery, automating routine and error-prone tasks, and consistently exceeding our end-user expectations.
[under: Qualifications and Skills] - Prior networking experience in remote/field support is a plus.
[under: Qualifications and Skills] - Microsoft Office 365 and common email clients, including Outlook for Windows, macOS, and iOS, Apple Mail, Outlook Web Access, Exchange Online, Active Directory and Azure AD, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Office Online
[under: Qualifications and Skills] - Must be able to effectively work remotely when scheduled to work off-site and when providing on-call coverage.
[under: Qualifications and Skills] - Be available to travel occasionally, both domestically and internationally, to support events, branch offices, and youth academies.
[under: Why MLB Network?] Cutting-edge technology is used to create MLB Network's Emmy Award-winning programming via roles in live studio and remote production, operations, engineering, media management, creative services, social media and others.

company: Simplesense
title: System Specialist
location: Denver, CO
field: -
description:
[under: System Specialist] Location: We prioritize candidates who reside in the Denver, CO area (hybrid as needed) but we are open to exceptional remote talent.
[under: About the Role] You will be responsible for keeping our hybrid infrastructure, spanning AWS GovCloud, on-prem Cisco edge networks, and complex identity systems resilient and mission-ready.
[under: About the Role] Work Model: We prioritize candidates who reside in the Denver, CO area (hybrid as needed) but we are open to exceptional remote talent.
[under: About the Role] - Locals: Onsite as needed for collaborative workspace time.
[under: About the Role] - Remote: Quarterly travel to hub locations for team syncs and alignment.
[under: What You’ll Do] - Troubleshoot and Resolve: Resolve network, OS, and cloud application access issues across hybrid environments. Safely execute automated scripts and remediation playbooks to resolve known issues while demonstrating disciplined production execution with operational rigor in live production environments.
[under: Required Qualifications] - Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a NOC, IT Operations, or hybrid Systems Support role, demonstrating a high degree of technical autonomy and operational discipline.
